reading.title: Scorpio Sun Squares Mars Under Saturn-Moon Conjunction
overview: The Sun at 29° Scorpio squares Mars at 28° Leo while the Moon at 8° Aries exactly conjoins Saturn at 8° Aries retrograde. Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto at 3° Aquarius, and Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto. These configurations occur with the Sun still in Scorpio and the Moon not void of course, its next aspect an opposition to Venus at 24° Libra.

Mundane tradition associates Sun-Mars squares with heightened tensions between leaders and assertive actions, while Uranus-Pluto aspects point to structural shifts and technological or revolutionary pressures. The Saturn-Moon conjunction in Aries suggests restrictive conditions on public sentiment or security matters. The last new moon at Scorpio 17° fell in the third house for the United States and the twelfth for Russia, Ukraine and Israel.

Transits to national charts include Neptune opposing the US MC, Mars opposing the US Moon, Pluto conjoining Russia's Saturn, and Pluto conjoining China's Moon and ASC. These stand alongside the listed aspects without any claimed predictive power beyond the computed positions.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 0.88° and Mars opposes the natal Moon within 0.72°. These transits coincide with reporting on US statements regarding Iran and China, though the fair-test records show no reliable link to such events.

Uranus squares the natal Moon within 1.4° and Pluto conjoins natal Saturn within 1.79°. The new moon fell in the twelfth house; today's reporting on missile activity aligns with the listed Mars-Jupiter conjunction but records indicate no better than chance association.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn within 1.85° and Neptune sextiles natal Saturn within 0.23°. The new moon was in the twelfth house; reporting of overnight strikes matches the Mars-Jupiter placement yet the tested Mars-affliction claims remain at chance levels.

Pluto opposes the natal Moon within 0.99° and Mars conjoins natal Mars within 0.41°. The new moon fell in the twelfth house; coverage of recovery and draft issues sits near the Sun-square-Mars aspect without exceeding chance in the records.

Saturn squares the natal Sun within 1.1° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter within 0.68°. The Uranus-Pluto trine overlaps with election-market data at z 6.8 and 6.1, though the fair tests do not confirm predictive value.

reading.lore_and_intel: Uranus trine Pluto and Sun square Mars overlap with Taiwan election markets and conflict reporting from South Africa, Nigeria-Ghana, Kyiv and the Gulf, while Neptune sextile Pluto aligns with recovery narratives and missile coverage; Sun opposition Uranus meets Hormuz and Israeli political items. No overlap appears with the listed China MSA warnings or routine cyber assessments, and the fair-test records show none of the claimed Mars or lunation effects exceed chance.

watch.note: Full Moon at Gemini 2°; monitor for any station or ingress effects listed in the almanac.
Saturn stations direct; note any concurrent Neptune station direct on the same day.
Jupiter stations retrograde and Neptune stations direct; observe alongside the Sagittarius new moon three days earlier.

reading.the_test: Mars afflicted versus Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts and Russian losses showed no better than chance across thousands of days. Full moons and eclipses versus the same alerts and worldwide magnitude 6+ earthquakes likewise performed at chance levels. The records therefore supply no evidence that these configurations predict the events in question.
